AllocateAnycastEipAddress.description_en: The AllocateAnycastEipAddress operation creates an Anycast EIP instance
AllocateAnycastEipAddress.description_zh: 调用AllocateAnycastEipAddress接口创建Anycast EIP实例

AssociateAnycastEipAddress.description_en: Associates an Anycast EIP with a specified backend cloud resource
AssociateAnycastEipAddress.description_zh: 调用AssociateAnycastEipAddress接口将Anycast EIP绑定到指定的后端云资源实例上

ChangeResourceGroup.description_en: Modifies the resource group to which an AnycastEipAddress instance belongs
ChangeResourceGroup.description_zh: 修改AnycastEipAddress实例所属的资源组

DescribeAnycastEipAddress.description_en: Queries the details of a specified Anycast EIP instance, including its status, peak bandwidth, and associated cloud resources
DescribeAnycastEipAddress.description_zh: 查询指定Anycast EIP实例的具体信息，包括实例状态、带宽峰值和已绑定资源的信息等

DescribeAnycastPopLocations.description_en: Queries the access points in a specified access area
DescribeAnycastPopLocations.description_zh: 调用DescribeAnycastPopLocations接口查询指定接入区域的接入点信息

DescribeAnycastServerRegions.description_en: Queries the regions where backend services can be attached to an Anycast EIP
DescribeAnycastServerRegions.description_zh: 调用DescribeAnycastServerRegions接口查询指定区域内Anycast EIP可绑定的后端服务地域

ListAnycastEipAddresses.description_en: Queries the details of Anycast EIPs in a specified access area, including their status, peak bandwidth, and information about bound cloud resources
ListAnycastEipAddresses.description_zh: 查询指定接入区域已创建Anycast EIP实例的具体信息，包括实例状态、带宽峰值和已绑定资源的信息等

ListTagResources.description_en: Queries the tags that are bound to Anycast elastic IP addresses (Anycast EIPs) by calling the ListTagResources operation
ListTagResources.description_zh: 调用ListTagResources接口查询任播弹性公网IP已绑定的标签列表信息

ModifyAnycastEipAddressAttribute.description_en: Changes the name and description of an Anycast EIP instance
ModifyAnycastEipAddressAttribute.description_zh: 调用ModifyAnycastEipAddressAttribute接口修改Anycast EIP实例的名称和描述

ModifyAnycastEipAddressSpec.description_en: Modifies the bandwidth of an Anycast EIP instance
ModifyAnycastEipAddressSpec.description_zh: 调用ModifyAnycastEipAddressSpec接口修改Anycast EIP实例带宽值

ReleaseAnycastEipAddress.description_zh: 调用ReleaseAnycastEipAddress接口释放指定Anycast EIP实例

TagResources.description_en: Creates and attaches tags to specified resources
TagResources.description_zh: 调用TagResources接口为指定的资源统一创建并绑定标签

UnassociateAnycastEipAddress.description_en: Disassociates an Anycast EIP from an endpoint
UnassociateAnycastEipAddress.description_zh: 调用UnassociateAnycastEipAddress接口来解除Anycast EIP与其绑定的后端云资源实例的关联

UntagResources.description_en: Detaches tags from Anycast EIPs in a batch
UntagResources.description_zh: 调用UntagResources接口为指定的Anycast EIP资源批量解绑标签

UpdateAnycastEipAddressAssociations.description_en: If an Anycast EIP instance is associated with backend resources in multiple regions, you can modify the mappings between access points and origin servers. You can call the UpdateAnycastEipAddressAssociations operation to add or remove access points for a specified origin server, which is an associated cloud resource instance
UpdateAnycastEipAddressAssociations.description_zh: 当Anycast EIP实例绑定了多个地域源站的后端资源时，支持修改接入点与源站的映射关系。您可以通过调用UpdateAnycastEipAddressAssociations接口增加或删除指定源站（绑定的云资源实例）的接入点来修改接入点与源站的映射关系
